description: Big Sur Station to Carmel along Highway 1 on the California coast. Rolling miles past Point Sur, the long climb to Hurricane Point (miles 10–12), Bixby Bridge at halfway, then coastal rollers and the Carmel Highlands hills in the last 5 miles. Unofficial.

source.notes: Route traced along California Highway 1 on OpenStreetMap; distances calibrated to features whose distances are published on the course's USATF certification (CA23018DT). Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (2018); the ten bridges, Bixby included, are interpolated between their ends, which matches their level decks. The lidar puts the start at 94 m and the finish at 8 m; official figures differ slightly (certificate 93 m and 3 m). Downhills, including the long descent from Hurricane Point to Bixby Bridge, are flat on a treadmill without decline. Landslides have occasionally forced a one-year out-and-back course from Carmel; this is the standard point-to-point course. Unofficial.
